name: Chaotic Storm Chronicle
reason: Source term 'Primal Chaos Herding Record' (ch 960) was renamed 'Chaotic Storm Chronicle' to fit the Western fantasy register of the adaptation.
description: An ancient book in the Immortal Mansion's archives: the travel journal of the original master, recording his journeys through the endless void/chaos beyond the universe's edge (Eps 983-987). Even so, it is said to be 'but a drop in the ocean' compared to the rest of the archives.

name: Celestial Essence Zane
reason: Extraction artifact, not an entity: the string comes from run-on phrasings such as 'the Celestial Essence Zane himself possessed' (Ep 202). The real entity is 'Celestial Essence', the material produced when the Cobalt Dragon absorbs a weapon.

name: Master Novak
issues: Dossier gender_signal reads m1/f0, but 'Master Novak' is explicitly a woman (Ep 57: 'a beautiful young woman... Master Novak was deeply worried'). She is Isla Novak, master of Misty Peak and the Sky Princess; the source counterpart Su Lingyun is also female, so the pronoun signal is noise, not a localization gender error.

name: Trista
issues: Distinct from the male 'Tristan' (antagonist Eps 56-58 with the Indigo Blade; House Lowell member Eps 326-329) despite the MasterLS notes attached by name similarity - do not merge. Possible gender flip: episodes present Trista as female (Ep 81: 'she was ranked thirtieth'), while the likely source counterpart (an outer-sect disciple ranked ~30th, chs ~66-70, e.g. Zuo Tao/Guo Ziyao) carries no female signal.
reason: The source disciple's Chinese name was fully localized; 'Trista' was chosen as a US-style feminine name for this Misty Peak pledge.
description: A Misty Peak pledge ranked thirtieth on the peak. Zane's upset victory over her as a newcomer was the feat that first made his reputation in the sect (Eps 81-107).

name: Merrick
reason: The character's Chinese name 'Xu Heng' was fully localized to the US-origin name 'Merrick' in keeping with the adaptation's Western setting.
description: An apprentice on the Sky Forest demon-slaying trial who was secretly killed and impersonated by a demon wearing his skin, revealed by his eerie cackle (Ep 112; source Xu Heng, ch 98).

name: Vitality Current
reason: Adaptation term, aligned with the show's 'Vitality' canon, for the absorbing current inside Zane's weaponized body; the source describes the phenomenon (whirlpools drawing in external power) without a fixed term in the evidence.
description: An energy current within Zane's Soul Armament body that ordinary opponents cannot stir; it was first truly awakened by the raw power of a demon general's blows (Eps 76-113).

name: Advanced Initiate
reason: The source cultivation realm 'Xiantian' (the stage below Divine Reflection, the show's 'Soul Realm') appears to be localized as the 'Initiate' rank; 'Advanced Initiate' marks its later stages.
description: A cultivation rank below the Soul Realm; defeating a Soul Realm warrior while still only an Advanced Initiate is treated as a stunning feat (Eps 117-132).

name: Physical Enhancement
reason: Localized umbrella term for the source's foundational body-refining stages (Bone Refinement, Marrow Refinement, etc.), renamed for the Western fantasy register.
description: The five foundational levels of body cultivation (Ep 95: 'The five levels of Physical Enhancement were the foundation'). Only a body purged of all toxins can advance toward the Nature Level, where Life Energy converts into Life Force.

name: Stone Golem
reason: An adaptation-flavor training construct in the Western fantasy register; no source counterpart appears in the evidence.
description: A stone training construct kept in practice rooms and used as a sparring partner (Eps 6-144).

name: Burning Vitality
reason: Source 'burning True Essence' (ch 174: the Divine Reflection Realm power that alone can break the Frost Seal) was localized following the show's 'Vitality' canon for the energy - MasterLS confirms it is NOT 'Burning Aether'.
description: An advanced technique of igniting one's own Vitality, possessed only by masters of the Soul Realm; it is the one power said to be able to shatter the Icy Seal (Eps 156-247).

name: Spirit Glyphs
reason: The source's 'spiritual inscriptions' - the marks that appear on a weapon (or on Luo Zheng's chest) to signify Spirit Weapon grade (ch 123) - were renamed 'Spirit Glyphs'.
description: Glyphs etched into Spirit Weapons, and into Zane's own weaponized body, marking a weapon's grade; the three Spirit Glyphs across his chest mark his body as a Top-Grade Spirit Weapon (Eps 156-415).

name: Earth's Core
reason: Source 'Earth Core Fire' was localized nearly literally as the 'Fire of the Earth's Core'.
description: A subterranean lava-born flame far purer than ordinary forge fire; it was one of the three fires that tempered Zane's body during his transformation into a living weapon (Eps 159-245; source chs 55-145).

name: Demon's Holy Fire
reason: Source 'Heavenly Devil Sacred Fire' - the third flame that tempered Luo Zheng's body (ch 145) - was renamed 'Demon's Holy Fire', matching the same flame trio listed in Ep 245.
description: A demonic sacred flame of exceptional purity, one of the three fires that tempered Zane's body; even the Meteor Flame's purity was nothing beside it (Eps 159-245).

name: Stormbreaker Halberd
issues: Split naming: Ep 16 also calls the same weapon 'Storm Pike' (noted in MasterLS as a localization inconsistency that was never corrected).
reason: The source's 'Thousand Revolutions Tribulation Thunder Halberd' (the family's most precious defensive treasure, ch 8) was shortened and renamed 'Stormbreaker Halberd' for the Western register.
description: A devastating halberd treasured by the family; the copy deployed against Zane was a death sentence on a direct hit (Ep 16), and its effectiveness only hinted at the true power of the original (Ep 334).

name: Acolyte's Sigil
reason: Localized term for the sect disciple's identity badge of the source, renamed for the Western fantasy register.
description: The identity badge worn by sect acolytes; Zane unclips and surrenders his without a word when taken in by the sect's justiciars (Eps 168-177).

name: Pen of Judgment
reason: The source's 'judge pen' (Qin Mu's Admonition Hall weapon, chs 155-161) was localized as 'Pen of Judgment'.
description: A metal stylus shaped like a brush - essentially a stabbing stiletto - wielded by the sect's disciplinary enforcers, who can condense Vitality characters with it to attack (Eps 169-255).

name: Crafting Formula
reason: Localized term for the weapon-refining recipes/blueprints of the source's forging system.
description: A recipe recording the materials and process required to forge a given weapon (Eps 17-93).

name: Emperor’s Token
reason: The source's 'Son of Heaven Token' (ch 158) was localized as 'Emperor's Token', a near-literal rendering of the imperial authority item.
description: A supremely precious token of imperial authority; onlookers are shocked that Isla would even consider spending one on a 'worthless outer disciple' like Zane (Eps 172-270).

name: House Walker
reason: The source's 'Meng Family' was localized as the noble 'House Walker' to fit the Western aristocratic register; its young master Knox Walker corresponds to Meng Changjun, Luo Yan's spurned pursuer.
description: One of the Empire's Seven Great Houses, courted by the Seventh Prince in the succession struggle (Eps 173-588). It brought the charges that condemned Elara after she brutally maimed its young master Knox Walker, her most relentless admirer - the official reason she was locked away on Infernal Peak.

name: Your Highness
reason: Generic royal honorific addressed to multiple different royals across the series (Eps 93-862), not an entity.

name: Icy Seal
reason: The source's 'Frost Seal' (Pei Hen's ice technique, ch 174) was localized as 'Icy Seal'.
description: Bob's signature ice-immobilization technique, perfected over countless hours and said by his father to be breakable only by the Burning Vitality of Soul Realm masters - yet Zane shatters it into crystalline dust (Ep 187).

name: Ruin Sword
reason: The source technique 'Sword of Ruins' (Mo Xiuyan's slashes carry its profound meaning, chs 191-193) was localized as 'Ruin Sword'.
description: A sword technique whose profound meaning laces its wielder's slashes (Eps 204-205).

name: Solar Flare
reason: Likely a renamed furnace/refining flame from the source's early forging chapters (e.g. the 'True Life Fire' used around the Hellfire Sword, ch ~11); 'Solar Flare' fits the Western fantasy register.
description: A furnace flame whose essence the growing whirlpools in Zane's body sucked right out of the forge during his early awakening as a living weapon (Ep 24).

name: Mad-Monster Hacking
reason: The source saber move 'Crazy Demon Chop' (Tian You's most powerful move, ch 229) was localized as 'Mad-Monster Hacking'.
description: The most powerful move of an opponent's saber arts, its real threat carried in a hidden trace of saber intent within the whirling blade qi (Eps 241-242).

name: Jeff
reason: The minor source disciple's Chinese name was replaced with the casual US name 'Jeff', fitting his brief ranked-opponent role.
description: A minor opponent ranked ninety-ninth in the Skyreach Sect Rankings, who had broken through to the Soul Realm only a year earlier (Ep 247).

name: Twins Fan
reason: Localized name of the fan weapon used in the source's competition arc (likely a 'two principles'-style fan, counterpart to the 'Eightfold' original); no source name appears in the evidence.
description: Cecil's feather fan, a Top-Grade Spirit Weapon and replica of the ancient Mythic Weapon 'Fan of the Eightfold Vitality'; even as a pale imitation it inherits a fraction of that power and conjures immense cyclones (Ep 250).

name: Hymn of Warding
reason: The source technique 'Song of Morality' (also rendered 'Righteous Song', Zhou Dan's defense, chs 247-253) was renamed 'Hymn of Warding' for the Western fantasy register.
description: A golden, righteous warding technique its caster believed unbreachable - until Zane's Corrupt Vitality wrapped around it and devoured its light (Eps 255-259).

name: Zane’s Corrupt Vitality
reason: The source's 'Heavenly Demon (Heavenly Devil) Vital Essence' - the devouring demonic energy in Luo Zheng's dantian - was renamed 'Corrupt Vitality' to align with the show's 'Vitality' canon for the energy system.
description: Zane's demonic strain of Vitality, which devours opposing energies such as the golden light of the Hymn of Warding; few have ever witnessed its true extent, so opponents routinely underestimate him (Eps 259-388).

name: Lotus Scriptures
reason: Localized name of Adrian's cultivation method from the source's competition arc; the specific source title does not appear in the evidence.
description: A rare, lotus-based cultivation method of which Adrian has profound mastery; Zane's harsh words paradoxically broadened Adrian's mind and gave him sudden insight into its very spirit (Eps 266-269).

name: Warrick
issues: Internal contradiction: Ep 88 calls Adrian Warrick 'the only son and heir of House Warrick', while MasterLS lists Caleb Warrick (Eps 89-93) as Adrian's brother - the house's family structure needs editorial review.

name: Jaden
reason: The elite source disciple's Chinese name was fully localized to the US-style name 'Jaden'; he corresponds to one of the source's top-ten personal disciples (Wen Fenqin/Yuan Xiao/Shi Lei, ch 259), though which one is not determinable from the evidence.
description: An elite Skyreach Sect disciple skilled enough to make the top ten of the Sect List, and Finn's first-round opponent in the sect competition (Ep 272).
